<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#16234d">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>tomytalez — a magazine of good reads</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:wght@500;700;800&family=Noto+Serif+Malayalam:wght@400;600&family=Source+Serif+4:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#16234d;--surface:rgba(255,255,255,.10);--ink:#f4f6ff;--muted:#bcc6e8;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.26);--accent:#9dbbff;--accent-ink:#0f1a3d;color-scheme:dark;
box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg)}
body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font:17px/1.65 "Source Serif 4","Noto Serif Malayalam",Georgia,serif;min-height:100vh;background-color:var(--bg);
background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 18px,transparent 18px 72px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 0 18px,transparent 18px 72px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.30) 0 2px,transparent 2px 72px),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.30) 0 2px,transparent 2px 72px),repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.14) 0 1px,transparent 1px 12px);
background-position:0 0,0 0,8px 8px,8px 8px,0 0}
.sans,h1,h2,h3,nav,button,input{font-family:"Bricolage Grotesque","Noto Serif Malayalam","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif}
button,input{font-size:15px}button{cursor:pointer}
.wrap{max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.glass,.card,.hero,.search input,.btn,nav a.on{-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-top:14px;padding-bottom:10px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-right:auto;font:800 26px/1 "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.logo span span{color:var(--accent)}
.mark{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;background:#fdfdf6;border:2px solid var(--line)}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:var(--ink);border-radius:20px;padding:7px 14px;font-weight:600}
.btn.pri{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
nav{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:6px 20px 12px;max-width:1040px;margin:0 auto}
nav a{flex:none;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:18px;border:1px solid transparent}
nav a.on{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);color:var(--ink);border-color:var(--line)}
.hero{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;margin-top:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(5,10,40,.35)}
.hero h2{font-size:clamp(24px,5vw,38px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:0 0 8px}
.hero p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);max-width:36ch}
.hero img{height:150px;width:auto;border-radius:14px;background:#fdfdf6;flex:none}
.search{margin:16px auto 0}
.search input{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:var(--ink);border-radius:12px;padding:11px 14px}
.search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted)}
h1.page{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,40px);letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:26px 0 4px}
.sub{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 18px}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(290px,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:18px}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;display:flex;flex-direction:column;text-align:left;padding:0;color:var(--ink);box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(5,10,40,.30)}
.cover{height:150px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:48px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,hsl(var(--h) 60% 62% / .55),hsl(calc(var(--h) + 40) 60% 40% / .55))}
.cb{padding:16px 18px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;flex:1}
.cb h3{margin:0;font-size:21px;line-height:1.22;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.cb p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px}
.by{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:auto;padding-top:10px}
.av{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:700 13px "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif;flex:none}
.tag{font:600 14px "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif;color:var(--accent)}
.pager{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin:28px 0}
.pager .btn[aria-current="page"]{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent)}
.empty{color:var(--muted);padding:30px 0}
.art{max-width:680px;margin:18px auto 0;padding:24px 24px 30px;background:rgba(18,30,70,.55);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(14px);backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}
.art h1{font-size:clamp(30px,6vw,44px);line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.03em;margin:8px 0 14px}
.art .cover{border-radius:14px;margin:20px 0 24px;height:200px}
.art p{margin:0 0 1.15em}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0}
.more{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:30px;padding-top:6px}
.more a{display:block;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font:600 17px "Bricolage Grotesque",Arial,sans-serif}
footer{border-top:1px solid var(--line);margin-top:30px;padding-top:24px;padding-bottom:40px;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px}
footer .links{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
footer a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-weight:600}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px}
.ml{font-family:"Noto Serif Malayalam",serif;line-height:1.9}
@media (max-width:520px){.hero img{height:110px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap top">
  <a class="logo" href="#/"><img class="mark" data-logo alt="tomytalez logo: smiling cartoon man in a checked shirt"><span>tomy<span>talez</span></span></a>
  <a class="btn pri" href="#sub" style="text-decoration:none">Subscribe</a>
</div>
<nav id="nav" aria-label="Topics"></nav>
<main class="wrap" id="main"></main>
<footer class="wrap" id="sub">
  <div class="links"><a href="#about">About us</a><a href="#contact">Contact us</a><a href="#support">Support us</a></div>

</footer>
<script>
var CATS=["All","Beyond the world","Under the world","Life & careers","Travel & places","Health & nursing","Stories & books"];
var ICON={"Beyond the world":["🔭",250],"Under the world":["🌊",190],"Life & careers":["🌱",140],"Travel & places":["🧭",30],"Health & nursing":["🩺",340],"Stories & books":["📖",280]};
var A=[
{id:1,cat:"Beyond the world",t:"What we still do not know about the night sky",d:"Most of the universe is invisible to us. Here is what scientists are chasing.",by:"Maya Okafor",dt:"Oct 14",min:6,body:["About 95 percent of the universe is made of dark matter and dark energy, neither of which we can see or fully explain.","New telescopes are now looking back more than 13 billion years, watching the first galaxies form and testing ideas about how stars are born.","You do not need equipment to start. On a clear night away from city lights, the Moon, a few planets and the brightest stars are enough to begin."]},
{id:2,cat:"Under the world",t:"Why the ocean floor is still mostly unmapped",d:"We have mapped other planets in more detail than our own seabed.",by:"Maya Okafor",dt:"Oct 12",min:5,body:["More than 80 percent of the ocean floor has never been mapped at high resolution. Light fades quickly with depth, and pressure rises fast.","Autonomous underwater vehicles now sweep the seabed for days at a time, and surveys are being pooled into one open global map.","Each survey finds surprises: new species near hydrothermal vents, underwater mountains, and ecosystems that live without sunlight."]},
{id:3,cat:"Life & careers",t:"Your first 90 days in a new job",d:"A simple plan to learn fast, ask well and build trust early.",by:"Priya Nair",dt:"Oct 10",min:5,body:["In the first month, listen more than you speak. Learn how work really gets done, who to ask, and what good looks like.","In the second month, take on one small task and finish it well. Early reliability matters more than big ideas.","By the third month, ask for feedback and write down what you have learned. A short list of wins is useful for your next review or application."]},
{id:4,cat:"Life & careers",t:"How to build a habit that survives a bad week",d:"Streaks break. The habits that last are designed for the days you miss.",by:"Priya Nair",dt:"Oct 8",min:4,body:["Most habit advice assumes perfect days. Real life brings travel, illness and long shifts.","Make the smallest version of the habit so easy that it counts on your worst day: two minutes of reading, five stretches, one line in a notebook.","Then follow one rule: never miss twice. One gap is a blip, and two is the start of a new pattern."]},
{id:5,cat:"Travel & places",t:"Small towns worth a long detour",d:"Quiet places often leave a bigger memory than famous landmarks.",by:"Daniel Reyes",dt:"Oct 6",min:5,body:["Big cities are crowded, but small towns let you slow down. A morning market, a local bakery and a walk with no plan can fill a day.","Ask residents where they eat and what they would show a visitor. The answers are rarely in guidebooks.","Stay at least two nights if you can. The second morning is when a place starts to feel familiar."]},
{id:6,cat:"Travel & places",t:"How to pack for a long trip with one bag",d:"Pack less, move easier, and still have what you need.",by:"Daniel Reyes",dt:"Oct 4",min:4,body:["Start by choosing a colour palette so everything matches. Pack for seven days and plan to wash clothes.","Keep a small pouch for documents, chargers and medicines, and keep it within reach at all times.","Leave space for the things you will bring back. A half-empty bag is a good sign."]},
{id:7,cat:"Health & nursing",t:"What a good shift handover looks like",d:"Clear handovers keep patients safe and help the next team start well.",by:"Amara Singh",dt:"Oct 2",min:5,body:["A strong handover is short, structured and specific. Many units use a simple order: who the patient is, what has happened, what you are watching, and what needs doing next.","Say what is urgent first. Mention recent changes, pending results and anything the patient or family has asked about.","Finish by checking that the next nurse has no questions. A moment of clarity here can prevent hours of confusion later."]},
{id:8,cat:"Health & nursing",t:"Looking after yourself in a caring job",d:"Small routines that help nurses and carers stay well on long shifts.",by:"Amara Singh",dt:"Sep 30",min:4,body:["Caring for others is demanding, so your own basics matter: water, regular meals, and a few minutes away from the ward when your break allows.","Plan sleep around your shift pattern. A dark room, a steady wind-down routine and limited screens help more than people expect.","Talk to a colleague you trust after hard days. If stress feels heavy for weeks, speak to a doctor or counsellor."]},
{id:9,cat:"Stories & books",t:"Why we remember stories better than facts",d:"The brain loves a beginning, a middle and a person to care about.",by:"Leo Hartmann",dt:"Sep 28",min:4,body:["A list of facts is easy to forget. A story gives those facts a shape: someone wants something, something gets in the way, and something changes.","That is why teachers, nurses and leaders who explain with an example are remembered long after the slides are gone.","Try it today. Pick one idea you want to share, and wrap it in a short true story from your own life."]},
{id:10,cat:"Stories & books",t:"How to start reading again",d:"Ten pages a day is enough to rebuild a reading habit.",by:"Leo Hartmann",dt:"Sep 26",min:3,body:["If reading feels hard, pick a short book you actually want to read. Quitting a book you dislike is allowed.","Set a small target, such as ten pages after dinner, and keep the book where you will see it.","Audiobooks count. Many readers use them for travel and chores, then return to print when they feel ready."]},
{id:11,cat:"Life & careers",ml:1,t:"ചെറിയ ശീലങ്ങൾ, വലിയ മാറ്റങ്ങൾ",d:"ദിവസവും ചെയ്യുന്ന ചെറിയ കാര്യങ്ങളാണ് ജീവിതത്തെ രൂപപ്പെടുത്തുന്നത്.",by:"Tomy",dt:"Sep 24",min:2,body:["വലിയ മാറ്റങ്ങൾ ഒറ്റ ദിവസം കൊണ്ട് സംഭവിക്കുന്നതല്ല. ദിവസവും ചെയ്യുന്ന ചെറിയ കാര്യങ്ങളാണ് ഒടുവിൽ നമ്മുടെ ജീവിതത്തെ രൂപപ്പെടുത്തുന്നത്.","ദിവസവും പത്തു പേജ് വായിക്കുക, അഞ്ചു മിനിറ്റ് നടക്കുക, ഒരു നല്ല വാക്ക് പറയുക. ഇവ ചെറുതായി തോന്നാം, പക്ഷേ മാസങ്ങൾ കഴിയുമ്പോൾ വലിയ വ്യത്യാസം കാണാം.","ഇന്ന് തന്നെ ഒരു ചെറിയ ശീലം തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കൂ. നാളെ അതു വീണ്ടും ചെയ്യൂ."]}
];
